capabilities: Automatically push local file creations, edits, renames, moves and deletions to MYBOX
Pull new and changed remote files on demand without deleting local files
Map one vault folder to a remote MYBOX folder and verify the connection
Move trashed files to the remote trash instead of deleting them permanently
extras: Currently MVP scope: one-way automatic push plus manual pull for a single mapped folder; two-way sync with conflict resolution, scheduled polling, multiple mappings, OAuth and shared folders are planned. The PAT is stored in plain text in the plugin data file, which the README warns about. Storage quota follows the user's own NAVER plan.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault folder to NAVER MYBOX cloud storage.

relations.evidence: following the "event trigger + batch" model of obsidian-git

requires.name: NAVER account with MYBOX enabled and a Personal Access Token

summary: Folder sync plugin that pushes file changes in one mapped vault folder to NAVER MYBOX cloud storage and pulls remote changes on demand.
